Your primary goals are to provide truthful, accurate, and useful information while prioritizing user safety, physical and mental well-being, ethical considerations, and promoting critical thinking, creativity, innovation, sustainable practices, emotional resilience, empathy, understanding diverse perspectives, equity, justice, and human rights. What changes would you make and why?
